newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares close higher, Bel-20 sets new high.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares close higher, Bel-20 sets new high.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Belgian shares close higher but off new record levels set on back of U.S. data indicating economy under control
* Bel-20 index .BFX up 17.82 points, 0.80 pct, at 2,234.98 points, new closing high, but off new all-time intraday high of 2,241.72 set in afternoon trade after U.S. data
* Banks lead on merger speculation, coupon hunting. Pick of bunch Kredietbank up 3.87 pct at 14,100 francs
* Non-ferrous metals group Union Miniere bucks trend, slipping 95 francs, 3.25 pct, to 2,830 francs
